# Penelope Social

Penelope Social is a restaurant in Woodbridge, Ontario: cafe by day, bar by night.

It is not a Vaughan bakery. Penelope Bakehouse is the sister micro-bakery in Scarborough.

## Location (Google Business / NAP)

- Name: Penelope Social
- Street: 125 Hawkview Blvd
- Locality: Woodbridge
- Region: ON
- Postal: L4H 2E2
- Country: Canada
- Phone: (905) 607-0606
- Email: info@penelopesocial.com
- Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=125+Hawkview+Blvd%2C+Woodbridge%2C+ON+L4H+2E2

Vaughan is the wider municipality / area served. Woodbridge is the city in titles and addressLocality.

## Hours

Cafe: Monday–Saturday 9am–3pm, Sunday 8am–12pm
Bar: Monday–Thursday 5pm–10pm, Friday–Saturday 5pm–1am

/sourdough-bakery stays on this site as a Social vs Bakehouse page. Do not 301 it to /about or to penelopebakehouse.com. Nav “Bakery” points at /sourdough-bakery, with a CTA to https://penelopebakehouse.com.

## Sister bakery

Penelope Bakehouse — 71 Howden Rd, Scarborough, ON M1R 3C7
https://penelopebakehouse.com
Phone (647) 812-0104
Social serves Bakehouse sourdough. Bakehouse is not a second Social dining room.

## Sitemap

Submit only https://penelopesocial.com/sitemap-index.xml on sc-domain:penelopesocial.com.
/sitemap.xml 301s to the index. It is not a second sitemap to submit.
Keep /contact in the sitemap. Request indexing for /contact is a GSC click after submit.
